nodes.question: What are the potential benefits of investing in high-speed rail and other intercity transportation options?
nodes.answer: Investing in high-speed rail and other intercity transportation options can reduce the reliance on air travel and long-distance car trips, improve connectivity between cities and regions, reduce travel times, and lower greenhouse gas emissions from transportation.
